summary: Iteration 10 — validated 6 new features: Student Analytics, Teacher Results + CSV, Batch CRUD, Reminder scheduler, Bookmarks page, BatchManagerDialog. 14/14 backend tests pass. Frontend verified: /analytics, /bookmarks, /teacher/tests/:id/results with working CSV download. Regression on teacher+student login passes.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warnings: `<tr>` wrapped inside a `<span data-ve-dynamic>` inside `<tbody>` — invalid HTML nesting (warning only, not breaking). Caused by ve-dynamic instrumentation wrapping each row.

action_items: LOW: Fix HTML nesting warning in TestResultsDetail.js — the ve-dynamic `<span style='display:contents'>` wrapper is being injected between `<tbody>` and each `<tr>`. Browser auto-corrects but emits hydration errors. Move row mapping so the wrapper isn't used, or use a React fragment.
critical_code_review_comments: student_analytics_routes.py, batch_routes.py, teacher_test_routes.py all use proper async/await + MongoDB ObjectId handling. No issues.
reminder_scheduler boots cleanly, log line 'Unified reminder scheduler started (tests + classes, 24h/1h/15m)' appears at each startup and no runtime exceptions for >60s window observed.
BatchCreateRequest requires `year` (2024-2035). Frontend BatchManagerDialog must send year; verify teacher UI form passes it.
seed_data_creation: A custom batch 'TEST_QA Batch 2027' is created and deleted during each test run. Test is idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Teacher lands on /teacher (not /dashboard). Results button is on /teacher/tests list. CSV download confirmed via Playwright expect_download. Analytics Leaderboard highlights logged-in user row with purple background (is_me flag working). The BatchManagerDialog lives inside the CreateTest form (click Create Test button) and the Schedule-New-Class modal on ManageClasses — it's not a top-level page button. Backend POST /api/batches/ requires {name, year}.
